# Hoori, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Hoori** works now.

Hoori's mythology is the bridge between the heavenly descent of Ninigi and the earthly reign of Jimmu. It is a story of exile, marriage, and return.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Hoori
- **Pantheon:** Japanese
- **Domain of influence:** Agriculture, Hunter
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Agriculture, Food & Harvest
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 177 of 437

## The Myth at Work

**The Lost Fishhook.** After exchanging gifts with his brother Hoderi, Hoori received the fishhook but lost it in the sea.  Hoderi refused any substitute. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Promise and the Broken Taboo.** Toyotama agreed to accompany Hoori to land on the condition that he not watch her give birth.  Curiosity overcame him; he peeked and saw her in her true form as a sea dragon or crocodile. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Agriculture, Food & Harvest

*Farming, grain, food production, and agtech. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The fire-subduing hunter and agricultural kami; the field and the hunt are his twin harvests.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Forestry, Conservation & Outdoor Industries

*Forestry, wildlife protection, and outdoor recreation. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The hunter of the high places; the wild wood and the chase are his realm.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Sports, Fitness & Competition

*Athletics, fitness brands, and competitive leagues. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*The hunter whose skill with bow and field defines the athletic chase.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Hoori performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

## The Long Employment

Hoori is remembered chiefly as an ancestor, but his story has inspired countless retellings.  The dragon-palace motif appears in folk tales, Noh plays, and modern fiction. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity’s documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in agriculture, food & harvest, forestry, conservation & outdoor industries, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/hoori/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
